title: Subject-Verb Agreement Nuances
completion_message: ¡Soberbio! El 'Subject-Verb Agreement' a nivel C2 requiere precisión quirúrgica. Saber cuándo usar singular o plural con palabras colectivas o cuantificadores complejos es lo que distingue a un hablante fluido de un verdadero maestro del idioma.

parts.visual:
1. Sustantivos Colectivos (The committee, the board, the team, the staff): 
- Singular: Si actúan como una sola unidad. 
Ej: The committee HAS reached a decision. 
- Plural: Si actúan como individuos separados o están en desacuerdo. 
Ej: The committee ARE divided on this issue. 

2. None of / Neither of / Either of: 
- Tradicionalmente/Formalmente: Toman verbo SINGULAR. 
Ej: None of the applicants IS qualified. 
- Informalmente: A veces se usa plural, pero en C2 o contextos formales es preferible el singular.
parts.audio: Number 1: Collective Nouns like committee, board, team, or staff. Use a singular verb if they act as a single unit. For example: The committee HAS reached a decision. Use a plural verb if the members are acting individually or are in disagreement. For example: The committee ARE divided on this issue. Number 2: None of, Neither of, and Either of. In strict formal grammar, these take a singular verb. For example: None of the applicants IS qualified. Or: Neither of the options SEEMS viable.

parts.visual:
3. A number of vs The number of: 
- A number of (Varios/Muchos): Verbo PLURAL. 
Ej: A number of problems HAVE arisen. 
- The number of (La cantidad específica): Verbo SINGULAR. 
Ej: The number of problems HAS increased. 

4. Frases Interpuestas (as well as, along with, together with): 
- NO cambian el sujeto principal. El verbo concuerda con el primer sustantivo. 
Ej: The CEO, along with the board members, IS attending the conference. 

5. Porcentajes y Fracciones: 
- Dependen del sustantivo que les sigue. 
Ej: 50% of the PIE IS eaten. 
Ej: 50% of the EMPLOYEES ARE happy.
parts.audio: Number 3: 'A number of' versus 'The number of'. 'A number of' means 'several' and takes a plural verb. For example: A number of problems HAVE arisen. 'The number of' refers to the specific count and takes a singular verb. For example: The number of problems HAS increased. Number 4: Intervening phrases like 'as well as' or 'along with'. These do not change the subject. The verb agrees with the first noun. For example: The CEO, along with the board members, IS attending the conference. Number 5: Percentages and Fractions. The verb depends on the noun that follows. For example: Fifty percent of the pie IS eaten, but fifty percent of the employees ARE happy.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige el verbo correcto prestando atención a la concordancia (Subject-Verb Agreement).

questions.question: The board of directors ____ finally reached a unanimous decision. (Unidad).
questions.explanation: Actúan como una unidad unánime: has.

questions.question: The jury ____ still arguing among themselves about the verdict. (Individuos en desacuerdo).
Neither of the two candidates ____ the necessary experience for this C-level role. (Formal).
questions.explanation: Neither of + sustantivo plural toma verbo singular en gramática formal: has.

questions.question: A number of critical vulnerabilities ____ discovered during the security audit.
questions.explanation: A number of (varias) toma verbo plural: were.

questions.question: The number of employees resigning this month ____ unprecedented.
questions.explanation: The number of (la cifra) toma verbo singular: is.

questions.question: The manager, along with his entire team, ____ flying to Tokyo tomorrow.
questions.explanation: El sujeto es 'The manager' (singular). 'Along with' no lo hace plural: is.

questions.question: Ten thousand dollars ____ too much to pay for that software license. (Cantidad de dinero como unidad).
questions.explanation: Cantidades de dinero, tiempo o distancia se consideran unidades singulares: is.

questions.question: Two-thirds of the factory ____ destroyed in the fire.
Two-thirds of the workers ____ going on strike tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Two-thirds of THE WORKERS (plural contable) -> are.

questions.question: None of the information you provided ____ accurate. (Formal).
questions.explanation: Information es incontable, por lo que es singular: is.

questions.question: None of the stakeholders ____ willing to compromise on this issue. (Formal).
questions.explanation: Formalmente, 'None of' toma verbo singular incluso con sustantivos plurales (is), aunque en inglés coloquial se escuche 'are'. C2 exige 'is'.

questions.question: The software, as well as the hardware components, ____ upgrading.
questions.explanation: El sujeto es 'The software' (singular). 'as well as' no afecta la concordancia: needs.

questions.question: Every one of the executives ____ a massive bonus this year.
The staff ____ complaining about the new office layout all week.
questions.explanation: Si actúan como individuos quejándose, se prefiere plural en UK/C2: have been (has been es aceptable en USA, pero 'complaining' implica multiplicidad de voces).

questions.question: Fifty percent of the budget ____ already been spent.
Neither the CEO nor the board members ____ aware of the fraud.
questions.explanation: En 'Neither A nor B', el verbo concuerda con el sustantivo más cercano (board members): were.

questions.question: Either the developers or the project manager ____ to take responsibility for this bug.
questions.explanation: En 'Either A or B', concuerda con el más cercano (project manager): has.

questions.question: Not only the employees but also the boss ____ furious about the decision.
questions.explanation: En 'Not only A but also B', concuerda con B (the boss): is.

questions.question: The majority of the applicants ____ missing the required certifications.
questions.explanation: The majority of + plural noun = verbo plural: are.

questions.question: Statistics ____ a very difficult subject in college, but these statistics ____ completely flawed.
questions.explanation: Statistics como materia es singular (was). Statistics como datos es plural (are).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe el verbo correcto (is/are, has/have, was/were).

questions.question: The committee ____ agreed. (Unidad - has/have)
The committee ____ arguing. (Individuos - is/are)
None of them ____ ready. (Formal - is/are)
A number of issues ____ found. (was/were)
The number of issues ____ five. (is/are)
John, along with his team, ____ here. (is/are)
Ten dollars ____ cheap. (is/are)
50% of the cake ____ gone. (is/are)
50% of the apples ____ gone. (is/are)
Neither he nor they ____ wrong. (is/are)
